Meet the studio

Good websites begin with understanding.

Tracy Base is a demo of an independent website studio. Its approach starts with the people a business needs to reach, then connects every part of the experience around them.

We work across the message, the visual identity and the build. Keeping those conversations together makes the work easier to review, easier to maintain and more useful after launch.

Clear thinkingConsidered designPractical delivery
What we do

One connected service. From idea to everyday use.

Bring us a new idea, an existing website or a question about what comes next.

Website strategy

Start with the people your website needs to help. We turn audience questions, business priorities and existing content into a clear page plan.

Brand and interface design

A recognisable website needs more than a logo. Colour, typography, photography and interaction should feel like parts of the same business.

Website development

A good design should remain useful after launch. We build pages around editable sections so your team can keep services, people and news up to date.

Content and photography

Specific words and relevant images help people understand what you do. We plan content around customer questions and choose visuals that explain the work.

Website care

Websites need attention as a business changes. A regular review helps keep contact information, services, software and the visitor journey current.

Planning a focused campaign page

A campaign page works best when its offer and audience are specific. The headline, supporting detail and action should all serve that one purpose.

Before we begin

A few useful answers.

What can a project include?+
A project can connect website strategy, content planning, identity, interface design and development. The brief defines which parts the business needs.
Can we start with an existing website?+
Yes. Start by reviewing the content, page structure and customer journeys. That review helps separate what is useful from what needs to change.
Will our team be able to edit the content?+
The demo uses native Joomla content and modules. A handover can explain where the different sections live and how to keep them current.
How do we decide the scope?+
Bring the existing site, the goals and the questions you have. The first step is to agree priorities, deliverables and responsibilities.
What happens after launch?+
Keep a list of customer questions and content changes. Regular reviews help the website follow the business as it grows and changes.
Start a conversation

What should your next website make possible?

Tell us about the business, the people you serve and the change you want to make. You do not need to arrive with every answer.
